versions.content: Using the CMAC algorithm based on AES-128 according to NIST SP 800-38B to calculate the MAC, don't use any freshness value at all and use the 24 most significant bits of the MAC as truncated MAC. The profile shall only be used if no synchronized freshness value is established. There is no restriction to a special bus.
